milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The coal ore cluster is centered at spawn-relative (3, 1, 3). Max_distance reduced to 4 blocks (from 8) to prevent instant completion at spawn — the player starts ~4.36 blocks away so they must walk at least 1 step toward the coal ore. Facing_tolerance of 60° ensures the player is actually looking at the coal ore, not just passing by.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The cut sandstone blocks are inside the sandstone building, centered around spawn-relative (9, 1, 5). Max_distance of 5 blocks requires the player to actually enter or stand at the building entrance (the building entrance is at x=8-10, z=2 spawn-relative, so the player must be inside or at the doorway). Facing_tolerance of 60° ensures the player is looking at the cut sandstone blocks.

Uses inventory_has because crafting sandstone_stairs results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The standard stair recipe uses 6 sandstone blocks (provided via /give) and yields exactly 4 sandstone_stairs. The player must use the crafting table inside the sandstone building to complete this craft. min_count=4 matches the exact recipe output.
